poem.title: นิราศภูเขาทอง (first 60 and 40 pairs)
poem.author: สุนทรภู่
poem.form: กลอนนิราศ: the end of the second wak rhymes with the end of the third, the end of the fourth with the end of the next second
poem.licence: public domain (author died more than 100 years ago); text from Wikisource, CC BY-SA 4.0 for the transcription
